description: Miguel Hernandez visits Kevin O'Brien's community center office hours to apply for a retraining stipend or grant applicable to his active enrollment in the MCC automotive service technician certificate program. He brings enrollment documentation and income verification. If approved, this represents $150/month in stipend support for an actively retraining low-wage worker in a high-displacement-risk sector. Outcome contingent on program availability and eligibility determination.
condition_description: Grant approved at community center office hours with Kevin O'Brien. Miguel is enrolled in an 8-month cert program, employed in a sector under direct RoboRide displacement pressure, with documented income at tier 4 and 1.6-month runway.
